comparison.objective: Calibrate a fixed tool tip by touching one reference point from four sufficiently different orientations.
comparison.physical_skill: Fine tip placement, low-force contact, submillimetre stillness, and controlled reorientation about a fixed point.
comparison.success_condition: Four one-second contacts with prescribed lean, tip-position, stability, and at least 15-degree inter-pose axis separation.
comparison.reason: It shares precision tip alignment and lateral-force discipline, but tests static multi-orientation contact calibration. The candidate requires dynamic bimanual hammer impacts, notch fracture, component-retention monitoring, and fragment collection.
